LASER_HEAVY_1.title: Heavy Laser Mark I
LASER_HEAVY_1.desc: High-impact 2-damage laser with fire & breach chance.

LASER_CHAINGUN.title: Chain Laser
LASER_CHAINGUN.desc: Cooldown drops by 3s after each shot (up to 3x).

LASER_CHAINGUN_2.title: Chain Vulcan
LASER_CHAINGUN_2.desc: Spools up to fire every 1.1 seconds!

SHOTGUN.title: Flak Gun Mark I
SHOTGUN.desc: Fires 3 debris shards across a 42px scatter zone.

SHOTGUN_2.title: Flak Gun Mark II
SHOTGUN_2.desc: Fires 7 debris shards across a 65px scatter zone.

MISSILES_BREACH.title: Breach Missile
MISSILES_BREACH.desc: Massive 4-damage missile with high breach chance.

BEAM_1.title: Mini Beam
BEAM_1.desc: Fast 1-power beam slicing 1 damage per room.

BEAM_2.title: Halberd Beam
BEAM_2.desc: Powerful 2-damage beam that cuts through 1 shield.

BEAM_FIRE.title: Fire Beam
BEAM_FIRE.desc: Ignites rooms across the enemy hull.

BEAM_BIO.title: Anti-Bio Beam
BEAM_BIO.desc: Harmless to hull, lethal to enemy crew.

BOMB_1.title: Small Bomb
BOMB_1.desc: Teleports past shields for 2 system & crew damage.

BOMB_FIRE.title: Fire Bomb
BOMB_FIRE.desc: Teleports an incendiary bomb into any room.

BOMB_ION.title: Ion Bomb
BOMB_ION.desc: Deals massive 4 ion damage past shields.

CRYSTAL_BURST_1.title: Crystal Burst Mark I
CRYSTAL_BURST_1.desc: Fires 2 shards that pierce 1 shield layer.

COMBAT_BEAM.title: Beam Drone Mark I
COMBAT_BEAM.desc: Orbits enemy ship slicing with a mini beam.

DEFENSE_2.title: Defense Drone Mark II
DEFENSE_2.desc: Shoots down missiles, lasers, flak, and ion.

BOARDER.title: Boarding Drone
BOARDER.desc: Breaches enemy hull and deploys a combat drone.

BATTLE.title: Anti-Personnel Drone
BATTLE.desc: Defends your ship against enemy boarders.

ENERGY_SHIELD.title: Zoltan Shield
ENERGY_SHIELD.desc: Starts every fight with a 5-point Super-Shield blocking weapons & boarding.

WEAPON_PREIGNITE.title: Weapon Pre-Igniter
WEAPON_PREIGNITE.desc: Weapons start fully charged at the start of every jump.

SCRAP_COLLECTOR.title: Scrap Recovery Arm
SCRAP_COLLECTOR.desc: Gain +10% bonus scrap from all salvage.

CLOAK_FIRE.title: Stealth Weapons
CLOAK_FIRE.desc: Firing weapons does not reduce Cloaking duration.

ROCK_ARMOR.title: Rock Plating
ROCK_ARMOR.desc: 15% chance to negate incoming hull damage.

NANO_MEDBAY.title: Engi Med-bot Dispersal
NANO_MEDBAY.desc: Heals all friendly crew ship-wide while Medbay is powered.

SLUG_GEL.title: Slug Repair Gel
SLUG_GEL.desc: Automatically seals hull breaches over time.

EXPLOSIVE_REPLICATOR.title: Explosive Replicator
EXPLOSIVE_REPLICATOR.desc: 50% chance not to consume missiles when firing.

RECON_TELEPORTER.title: Reconstructive Teleport
RECON_TELEPORTER.desc: Crew heal to 100% HP whenever teleporting.

REPAIR_ARM.title: Hull Repair Arm
REPAIR_ARM.desc: Repairs +2 Hull on combat salvage (-15% scrap).

DRONE_RECOVERY.title: Drone Recovery Arm
DRONE_RECOVERY.desc: Recovers active external drone parts after combat.

FTL_JUMPER.title: Adv. FTL Navigation
FTL_JUMPER.desc: Allows jumping back to any previously visited beacon.

LONG_RANGED_SCANNERS.title: Long-Ranged Scanners
LONG_RANGED_SCANNERS.desc: Reveals hostile ships and hazards on adjacent beacons.

PLAYER_SHIP_HARD.name: The Kestrel
PLAYER_SHIP_HARD.desc: Reliable Federation cruiser balanced for all-around combat.

PLAYER_SHIP_CIRCLE.name: The Torus
PLAYER_SHIP_CIRCLE.desc: Drone-focused Engi cruiser equipped with Ion Blast II and Med-bot Dispersal.

PLAYER_SHIP_FED.name: The Osprey
PLAYER_SHIP_FED.desc: Features an automatic shield-piercing Artillery Beam.

PLAYER_SHIP_ENERGY.name: The Adjudicator
PLAYER_SHIP_ENERGY.desc: Protected by a 5-point Zoltan Super-Shield and armed with a Halberd Beam.

PLAYER_SHIP_MANTIS.name: The Gila Monster
PLAYER_SHIP_MANTIS.desc: Built for aggressive Crew Teleporter boarding raids.

PLAYER_SHIP_SLUG.name: Man of War
PLAYER_SHIP_SLUG.desc: Equipped with Anti-Bio Beam, Slug Telepathy, and automatic breach-sealing gel.

PLAYER_SHIP_ROCK.name: Bulwark
PLAYER_SHIP_ROCK.desc: Heavily armored hull with Rock Plating and fire-immune crew.

PLAYER_SHIP_STEALTH.name: The Nesasio
PLAYER_SHIP_STEALTH.desc: Starts without Shields, relying on Cloaking, high evasion, and Long-Ranged Scanners.

PLAYER_SHIP_ANAEROBIC.name: Kruos
PLAYER_SHIP_ANAEROBIC.desc: Advanced Edition cruiser featuring Clone Bay, Hacking, Chain Laser, and Flak I.

PLAYER_SHIP_CRYSTAL.name: Bravais
PLAYER_SHIP_CRYSTAL.desc: Ancient vessel crewed by Crystal beings with room Lockdown (K) and shield-piercing shards.

AUTO_BASIC.name: Rebel Auto-Scout
AUTO_BASIC.desc: Unmanned AI scout ship with self-repair.

BOSS_2.name: Rebel Flagship (Phase 2)
BOSS_2.desc: Armed with Drone Power Surges & Boarding Drones.

START_BEACON.text: Welcome to the Federation Fleet! Carry vital intelligence across 8 sectors and destroy the Rebel Flagship.

choices.text: Begin Mission (임무 시작)

HOSTILE_PIRATE.text: A pirate cruiser drops out of FTL and locks weapons onto your hull!

choices.text: Battle Stations!

DISTRESS_MINER.text: A civilian mining station is on fire after a solar flare! They plead for help.

choices.text: [BLUE ROCK] Send your Rock crew into the flames to rescue survivors.

event.text: Your fire-immune Rock crew pulls everyone out safely! The grateful miners reward you generously.

choices.text: [BLUE TELEPORTER] Beam the trapped miners directly aboard.

event.text: You lock onto their biosigns and beam them out cleanly. They transfer scrap and a weapon schematic!

choices.text: Dock and help put out the fire.

event.text: You extinguish the blaze with minor hull scorching and receive salvage.

choices.text: Leave them — too risky.

event.text: You power up your FTL drive and move on.

QUEST_CACHE.text: A retired Federation scout offers coordinates to a hidden weapons cache in this sector.

choices.text: Upload the coordinates to your Star Map.

event.text: A golden QUEST beacon has been marked on your Star Map!

choices.text: Decline politely.

event.text: The scout wishes you luck against the Rebels.

QUEST_CACHE_REWARD.text: You arrive at the secret Federation supply cache hidden inside an asteroid belt!

choices.text: Open the vault and salvage the supplies.

event.text: Inside you find pristine weapons and a huge stash of scrap!

ENGI_HELP.text: An Engi research vessel has suffered a reactor core cascade failure.

choices.text: [BLUE ENGI] Have your Engi crew stabilize their nanite core.

event.text: Your Engi repairs the core effortlessly! They reward you generously.

choices.text: [BLUE SENSORS] Scan the core remotely to guide them.

event.text: Your upgraded sensors pinpoint the fault immediately.

choices.text: Offer assistance to jump-start their backup cells.

event.text: They thank you and transfer scrap in return.

MERCHANT_DRIFT.text: A wandering merchant convoy hails you near the beacon.

choices.text: Open Trading Post (상점 열기)
Move on.

DERELICT_POD.text: You spot an intact escape pod drifting beside a shattered cruiser.

choices.text: Recover the pod and open it.

event.text: A grateful survivor joins your crew!

choices.text: [BLUE CLONEBAY] Scan neural patterns before opening.

event.text: You safely revive a veteran Mantis warrior who pledges loyalty to your ship!

choices.text: Leave it alone.

event.text: You leave the pod drifting in the void.

REBEL_AMBUSH.text: A Rebel patrol intercepts your transponder signal!

choices.text: [BLUE CLOAKING] Engage Cloaking and slip past undetected.

event.text: You vanish from their sensors and salvage an unguarded supply buoy.

choices.text: [BLUE ENGINES] Burn full thrust to outrun them.

event.text: Your powerful engines leave the Rebel patrol in the dust.

choices.text: Stand and fight!

event.text: Weapons hot — engage the Rebel patrol!

NEBULA_SMUGGLER.text: Inside the dense nebula, a Slug smuggler offers a mysterious cargo crate.

choices.text: [BLUE SLUG] Read their mind to verify the deal.

event.text: You expose their hidden stash and claim the real treasure!

choices.text: [BLUE LONG_RANGED_SCANNERS] Scan the crate before docking.

event.text: Your scanners detect a trap — you ambush the smugglers first!

choices.text: Accept the trade.

event.text: The crate holds useful fuel and scrap.
